concept.description: Labels every type contained in a test-classes artifact as :Test.
concept.cypher: MATCH (a:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE a.fileName ENDS WITH 'test-classes' SET t:Test RETURN count(DISTINCT t) AS TestTypes

constraint.description: Tests that open private members (setAccessible / ReflectionTestUtils) are coupled to implementation details.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type:Test)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(rt:Type) WHERE (coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'setAccessible' AND rt.fqn STARTS WITH 'java.lang.reflect.') OR rt.fqn = 'org.springframework.test.util.ReflectionTestUtils' RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, rt.fqn + '#' + coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) AS Detail
